researchIterations.method: Six parallel independent research agents plus main-thread synthesis.

agents.summary: Confirmed official identity/order, 14 km/easy difficulty, main narrative places, shelters/TC, Mösjön water note, Marsbäcken connector, loops, acute-info status, and official contradictions.
Analyzed official GPX/API site 21836, OSM relation 3199980, reversed direction, 14 km vs 11.75 km contradiction, section 3/5 handoffs, and connector branch/geometry.
Found mainline endpoint shelter/toilet clusters, Valstad/Törnsfall facilities, Soluppgång, Törnsfalls kyrka, Mösjön water pending, and connector facilities including Gagern and Rock View.
Identified Valstad seasonal rail and KLT alternatives, Törnsfall Närtrafik/Kvistrum options, Hjortekrog off-route access, and strong Marsbäcken/Gertrudsvik/Västervik connector transit.
Found sparse direct recent reporting, a 2026-updated guide with Hjorten vegetation and Mösjön reeds, older direct wet/fallen-tree reports, and route-app absence-of-signal caveats.

Found no Etapp 4 acute notice, confirmed Hjorten/Vångaren water-protection-area overlap, no direct nature reserve/Natura 2000 route intersection, dynamic fire-ban status, water reliability caveats, and general dog/livestock/hunting rules.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Good enough for research-ready handoff. Do not run a second broad six-lane batch now; remaining issues are specific normalization/import blockers around distance display, reversed geometry, endpoint snapping, Mösjön water, connector marking, and access/parking verification.
